notes: RRB ALP and Technician cutoffs are **zone-wise** (and, for Technician Grade III, **trade-category-wise**), so there is no single national cutoff. Each Railway Recruitment Board publishes its own figures in its result notices. The rows below are **representative official figures from RRB Secunderabad's own result PDFs** for the last two completed cycles, to show realistic levels; your zone's exact cutoff comes from its own RRB website. Marks are **normalised** scores. The ALP 2024 cycle used 70:30 weighting between CBT 2 Part A and CBAT for the final shortlist; the 2026 CEN has moved this to 50:50, so cutoff levels are not directly comparable across cycles. Qualifying baselines (not the actual cutoffs) are 40% UR/EWS, 30% OBC-NCL/SC and 25% ST.

cbt1.note: Normalised CBT 1 cutoffs declared 26 February 2025; CBT 1 was held from 25 November 2024. Around 22 lakh candidates had appeared in this CBT 1 as per press reports.
CBT 2 (Part A) cutoffs declared 2 July 2025 for candidates shortlisted for the CBAT. Reserved-category figures sit near the qualifying baselines because shortlisting ran against community points.

final.stage: After CBAT → DV shortlist (70% CBT 2 Part A + 30% CBAT)
final.note: Declared 1 October 2025 with the CBAT result. RRB Secunderabad covers the ECoR and SCR zones, and it runs a separate cutoff row for each zone.
